en: Tinted view of a large timber‑framed hotel in a wooded setting with a rooftop sign reading "KÖNIGIN EMMA." Caption at bottom reads "Friedensthal bei Bad Pyrmont. Hotel u. Pension Königin Emma." The address side has "Postkarte," two green 5‑Pfennig Deutsches Reich stamps cancelled "LÖWENSEN 28.7.04," a receiving postmark "AMSTERDAM 29.7.04," publisher line "Verlag: Richard Borek, Braunschweig," a collection stamp "MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT," and a handwritten address to Amsterdam.
